chunks: Our Lord, indeed You will gather the people for a day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says He will gather mankind on a day of no doubt?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently recited in the Fatiha of the dead and during congregational prayers to affirm the inevitability of the Ma'ad (Resurrection), emphasizing that the gathering is not merely physical but a manifestation of divine truth. It underscores the concept of 'Adl (Divine Justice), assuring believers that the promise of accountability is absolute, thereby reinforcing the spiritual certainty required for moral accountability in this life.
